concerns.text: FR-001 requires that generated networks have exactly N=500 nodes. T012’s verification only checks file creation; it does not assert the node count, weakening the reproducibility guarantee.

FR-001 also mandates reproducible structural metrics. T013’s verification validates JSON schema but does not confirm that the metrics correspond to a 500‑node graph, leaving the requirement under‑specified.

FR-002 specifies the HK update rule must respect the confidence condition |x_i‑x_j| ≤ ε. T017’s unit test checks convergence but does not verify that the update rule enforces the ε‑bound, risking a semantic weakening of the rule.
The implementation task T019 introduces the simulation engine but lacks a verification step that the engine applies the bounded‑confidence condition, further weakening FR‑002.

SC‑001 (R² ≥ 0.8 for at least two topologies) is a success criterion, yet no task asserts that the fitted power‑law meets this threshold. The verification for T029 only checks schema compliance, not the statistical quality of the fit.

SC‑002 (p‑value < 0.05 for at least one structural metric) is not verified. T030’s verification only confirms file creation and schema validity, not that any regression coefficient achieves statistical significance.

FR‑007 mandates a maximum iteration limit per simulation to prevent infinite loops. T018 tests timeout handling but does not enforce a concrete iteration cap in the production code, leaving the requirement unimplemented.
T045 claims a ≥ 20 % speed‑up and total runtime ≤ 5 h, yet provides no verification that these performance targets are actually met. This weakens the performance guarantee implied by the plan.
The Methods & Results document is listed as a deliverable, but no task creates `docs/methods_results.md`. The missing artifact violates the hand‑off requirement.

The placeholder regression‑data schema is placed under `code/contracts/` while the project’s contract directory is `specs/...`. This path mismatch can break schema validation pipelines, effectively weakening contract enforcement.
